questions.question: Which data source do you want to pull jobs from?

options.label: Aggregator API (JSearch/Adzuna)
options.description: Legit API, ~free tier, covers LinkedIn/Indeed/Glassdoor postings. No login needed. Cleanest path.

options.label: LinkedIn directly (browser/scrape)
options.description: Drives your logged-in LinkedIn session. Richer data (Easy Apply, your network signals) but against ToS and can get your account restricted.

options.label: Both — aggregator now, LinkedIn later
options.description: Start with the safe API to iterate on filters/ranking, add LinkedIn driver later if needed.

questions.question: How should I deliver the integration?

options.label: Local MCP server in this repo
options.description: A small MCP server Claude Code can call as tools (search_jobs, get_job, save_job). Reusable across sessions.

options.label: Plain CLI scripts in this repo
options.description: Python/Node scripts I run via Bash. Faster to prototype, no MCP wiring.

options.label: Claude Code skill
options.description: A skill under .claude/skills/ that bundles the search workflow + your criteria. Good if the value is the prompt/process, not the tools.

transcript_tail.text: Is there a LinkedIn or plugin for Claude code, uh, or MCP, uh, and or SKU or something? And, um, if not, uh, can we build a quick integration with LinkedIn so that I can… we can do some job searches? I’ll… we’ll narrow down what I’m looking for and, you know, help me look for it. Um,

Short answer: there's no official LinkedIn MCP from Anthropic, but a few community LinkedIn MCP servers exist on GitHub (mostly unofficial scrapers/wrappers around `linkedin-api` or Playwright). LinkedIn's official Jobs API is gated and not granted for personal use, so any "quick" integration realistically means either (a) a third-party job-board API like JSearch/Adzuna/Indeed that aggregates LinkedIn-style postings, or (b) a browser-automation MCP that drives LinkedIn while you're logged in — which works but technically violates LinkedIn's ToS and risks account flags.
